description: Split long text into chunks for a model context window. Cuts at sentence boundaries when possible, then at word boundaries, and never mid-word unless a single word is longer than max_chars. Returns each chunk with exact start/end offsets into the original string plus an optional overlap for context carry-over.

overlap.description: Characters of the previous chunk to repeat, snapped to a word start. At most half of max_chars.

name: text_chunk
title: Chunk text
